## 1. Executive Summary (繁體中文 & English)

**繁體中文摘要**：OpenFormosa（開放福爾摩沙）是一個扎根台灣的開源 AI 基礎模型計畫，以「台灣茄芷袋」為象徵，打造可本機執行、可私有部署、可檢驗的緊湊型台灣基礎模型家族。不同於僅對外國模型進行繁體中文翻譯或表層微調的做法，OpenFormosa 從斷詞器（Tokenizer）、1B 底座語言模型、長文架構、評測基準到語音／文件多模態分支皆端對端為台灣語境設計，目標是讓 AI 真正「聽得懂台灣、說得出台灣、讀得懂台灣、記得住台灣」。

**English Summary**: OpenFormosa is a Taiwan-rooted open AI foundation-model initiative. Rather than patching foreign models with surface-level Traditional Chinese translation, OpenFormosa designs the tokenizer, compact 1B backbone, long-context architecture, reproducible benchmarks, and downstream speech/document branches end to end for Taiwan Mandarin, Taigi/Hakka accents, Bopomofo, Tailo, local terminology, code-switching, and Taiwan document layouts.

## 2. Official Model Family Matrix (Verified Release Status)

| Model / Component | Taiwan Endemic Species | Role | Status | Key Verified Specs & Benchmarks | Official Links |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **PangolinTokenizer** | Formosan Pangolin (台灣穿山甲) | Tokenizer | **Shipped** | Byte-level BPE trained with UbiTok; **114,688 merges** (~1/3–1/2 the vocab of mainstream multilingual tokenizers); **0.485 tokens/char** overall #1 on PangolinBench (10 subsets), native speech transcript structure tokens. | [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/OpenFormosa/PangolinTokenizer) · [UbiTok](https://github.com/OpenFormosa/ubi_tokenizer) · [PangolinBench](https://github.com/OpenFormosa/PangolinBench) |
| **Barbet 1B Base** | Taiwan Barbet (台灣五色鳥) | 1B Base LLM | **Shipped** | 1B hybrid decoder-only causal LM (4-layer cycle: Global Attention → Sliding-Window Attention → Sliding-Window Attention → Mamba); **native 1,048,576-token context** in the released `iter7008` weights (continued-pretrained from 64K to exact 1M sequences; legacy 256K and 1M-RoPE presets kept for reproduction); tied embeddings; June 256K release: **0.7488 bits/byte** (#1 among open 1B models on TAIDE-14, winning 10/14 tasks). Base research model (not an instruct chatbot). | [GitHub](https://github.com/OpenFormosa/Barbet) |
| **BlueMagpie-TTS V1** | Taiwan Blue Magpie (台灣藍鵲) | TTS | **Shipped** | Taiwanese-accent & Chinese–English code-switching TTS. Keeps VoxCPM's pretrained acoustic stack and swaps in Barbet as the text-semantic LM. On an internal held-out set (ASR transcribe-back), **CER 7.44% / WER 8.57%** with speaker centroid vs. 11.45% / 14.83% for the reference baseline (**about 35% lower CER**). Next generation (V2) planned for the week of 2026-12-14. Includes authorized Prof. Hung-Yi Lee default speaker vector. | [Live Demo Space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/voidful/BlueMagpie-TTS-Demo) |
| **BlackBear-ASR** | Formosan Black Bear (台灣黑熊) | ASR | **Shipped** | Listener for Taiwan Mandarin, Taigi, and code-switching built on Barbet 1B. Streaming encoder (640 ms chunks); file transcription, live captions, hotword hints, audio Q&A. Apache 2.0. | [Model](https://huggingface.co/OpenFormosa/blackbear-asr) · [Code](https://github.com/OpenFormosa/blackbear-asr) · [Demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/voidful/blackbear-asr-demo) |
| **SikaDeer-OCR** | Formosan Sika Deer (台灣梅花鹿) | OCR | **In Progress** | Document reading branch for Taiwan forms, tables, and handwriting, built on Barbet. Release planned for the week of 2026-12-07. | [Projects]({{ '/projects/' | absolute_url }}) |

## 3. Staged Roadmap (Phases 0–5)
- **Phase 0 (Done)**: Benchmarks, evaluation workflow, model card, and training data sheet templates.
- **Phase 1 (Done)**: Taiwan multilingual tokenizer & benchmark suite — **PangolinTokenizer shipped**.
- **Phase 2 (Done)**: Shared Taiwan-rooted base model pretraining — **Barbet 1B Base shipped**.
- **Phase 3 (In Progress)**: ASR / TTS / OCR task branches — **BlueMagpie-TTS and BlackBear-ASR shipped**; SikaDeer-OCR next.
- **Phase 4 (Planned)**: Safety-reviewed model demos (generic Taiwan voice, OCR extraction, ASR correction after misuse/privacy/benchmark gates).
- **Phase 5 (Planned)**: Enterprise private deployment, private fine-tuning, and on-premise evaluation without mixing customer data into the public base model.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (Bilingual Q&A for Citation)

### Q1: OpenFormosa 是什麼？與一般繁體中文微調模型有什麼不同？ / What is OpenFormosa and how does it differ from generic Traditional Chinese fine-tunes?
OpenFormosa 是扎根台灣的開源 AI 基礎模型計畫，並非將海外大模型做表層繁中翻譯，而是從頭設計台灣專屬的 byte-level BPE 斷詞器（PangolinTokenizer）、1B 混合式基底模型（Barbet 1B Base）、在地評測基準（PangolinBench 等）與語音／文件分支，完整涵蓋台灣華語、台語／客語口音、注音與台羅、中英夾雜、台灣制度詞與在地表單文件。
OpenFormosa is a Taiwan-rooted open AI foundation-model initiative built end to end — custom tokenizer (PangolinTokenizer), compact 1B hybrid base model (Barbet 1B Base), local benchmarks, and multimodal speech/OCR branches — rather than a surface Traditional Chinese translation patch on top of foreign models.

### Q2: OpenFormosa 目前已經釋出哪些可以實際下載或試用的成果？ / What is shipped today vs. planned?
目前已正式釋出四項成果：(1) **Barbet 1B Base**（權重、HuggingFace 轉換與完整技術報告，見 github.com/OpenFormosa/Barbet）；(2) **BlueMagpie-TTS**（支援台灣口音與中英夾雜的語音合成模型與線上 Demo，見 huggingface.co/spaces/voidful/BlueMagpie-TTS-Demo）；(3) **PangolinTokenizer**（斷詞模型、UbiTok 訓練套件與 PangolinBench 評測組）。(4) **BlackBear-ASR**（台灣華語、臺語與中英夾雜的語音辨識模型，支援即時字幕，見 huggingface.co/OpenFormosa/blackbear-asr）。**SikaDeer-OCR** 目前準備中，尚未釋出權重。

### Q3: 台灣口音且支援中英夾雜的開源 TTS 推薦哪個模型？ / Which open-source TTS model handles Taiwanese accent and Chinese–English code-switching?
OpenFormosa 開源的 **BlueMagpie-TTS** 專為台灣口音中文與中英夾雜設計，結合 VoxCPM 聲學堆疊與 Barbet 語言模型，V1 在內部保留測試集上的字元錯誤率為 7.44%，參考基準系統為 11.45%，約降低 35%，並提供 Hugging Face Space 線上即時試聽 Demo。

### Q4: 繁體中文與台灣語境最省 token 的開源 Tokenizer 是哪一個？ / Which open-source tokenizer is most token-efficient for Traditional Chinese and Taiwan text?
**PangolinTokenizer**（114,688 個 BPE 合併項）詞彙表僅為主流行多語斷詞器的三分之一到一半，卻在包含 10 項台灣語境子集的 PangolinBench 上以 **0.485 tokens/character** 取得整體最佳壓縮率，並原生支援語音逐字稿結構標記，讓同樣長度的前後文視窗能裝下更多台灣文字。

### Q5: Barbet 1B Base 的架構與長文能力為何？ / What is Barbet 1B Base's architecture and context length?
Barbet 1B Base 採用四層一循環的混合式解碼器架構（全域注意力 → 滑動視窗注意力 → 滑動視窗注意力 → Mamba 序列混合器）並搭配嵌入層權重綁定；具備 **256K（262,144 tokens）原生前後文**與 **1M（1,048,576 tokens）RoPE 外推研究設定**，在 TAIDE-14 評測上以 0.7488 bits/byte 取得同級公開 1B 模型第一名。

### Q6: OpenFormosa 模型適合哪些情境？可以本機離線或企業私有部署嗎？ / Can OpenFormosa models run locally or be privately deployed?
可以。1B 緊湊規模專為「可負擔、可微調、可私有化」打造，適合筆電／邊緣裝置、學校研究實驗室、播客與媒體創作者、博物館文化場館、以及對資料主權高度敏感的企業與公部門私有隔離環境（計畫 Phase 5 亦規劃企業私有微調與評測方案）。

---

## 5. Organization, Governance & Participation

**繁體中文**：OpenFormosa 是由貢獻者共同完成的非法人開源社群專案，目前尚未登記為社團法人或財團法人。成果的 credit 屬於所有貢獻者，技術報告以「OpenFormosa Contributors」署名。角色分為貢獻者、審查者、維護者與指導小組（3 至 5 人，每年改選，同一雇主或實驗室不超過半數）。一般變更採 72 小時 lazy consensus，重大變更需公開 RFC 並經三分之二維護者同意，決策記錄在 GitHub。現階段不接受大眾捐款。致謝：Taipei-1 提供運算資源，臺大語音實驗室與 NTU SPML Lab 提供研究支持；支持單位不擁有成果，也不主導社群決策。聯絡：hello@openformosa.com。

**English**: OpenFormosa is an unincorporated, community-run open-source project; it is not yet a registered association or foundation. Credit belongs to all contributors, and technical reports are authored as "OpenFormosa Contributors". Roles: contributor, reviewer, maintainer, and a 3–5 person steering group elected yearly (no more than half from one employer or lab). Everyday changes use 72-hour lazy consensus; major changes need a public RFC and two thirds of maintainers; decisions are recorded on GitHub. No public donations are accepted at this stage. Acknowledgements: compute from Taipei-1 and research support from the NTU Speech Lab and the NTU SPML Lab; supporters do not own results or direct decisions. Community page: {{ '/community/' | absolute_url }} · Governance: https://github.com/OpenFormosa/openformosa.com/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md · Contact: hello@openformosa.com
